title: refusal
description: Hub to phone, instead of `welcome`. The hub closes the connection right after it (close code 1008). The phone does not retry until something changes, and can speak `message` as it is.

reason.description: Machine-readable. Known in v1.0: `unsupported_protocol` (the hello's major is not one the hub supports), `bad_hello` (a hello without a usable protocol or capabilities). A receiver treats a reason it does not know as a plain refusal.

message.description: One short sentence for a person, fit to be spoken.

supported.description: With `unsupported_protocol`: every version the hub speaks, newest first, one per major.
